name: ryu.serper
description: Google's own search results as JSON via the Serper API (https://serper.dev), plus single-page scraping, exposed as two declarative HTTP tools. Provides the swappable `web.search` and `web.extract` layers, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web__search` / `web__extract` tools at Serper without changing what agents call. Serper is a paid, credit-metered API with a free allowance; requires a BYOK Serper API key.
